newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Endemol buys South African TV producer.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Endemol buys South African TV producer.

text.p: Dutch television production firm Endemol Entertainment said on Wednesday that it had acquired South African TV production company IFC Toron.
A spokesman said the move was was part of the company's expansion stategy and no financial details were disclosed.
This is the first acquisition for fledgling Dutch public group, which was listed in Amsterdam on November 1, netting the company an estimated 200 million guilders.
IFC Toron, which employs 9 people, will absorb Endemol's small office recently opened in South Africa and the new entity will be named Endemol Productions South Africa.
Endemol said it considered South Africa to be an interesting market as several new television channels will start broadcasting soon.
The entertainment group plans to announce one or more acquisitions or joint ventures before the end of this year.
"That is why we floated the company on the stock market," the spokeman said.
He said that the next expansion would probably be in Europe.
"Looking at Germany, the U.S. and Eastern Europe, one could say our interests lay in these regions in decreasing order."
